en-us:
Local colour-finishing workflows for SDR projects.

- Select a hue range with saturation/lightness bounds and feathering, then correct only those colours with the new HSL qualifier.
- Capture a reference shot and match another video or image using local RGB mean/contrast analysis. Corrections are saved and undoable; preview and export share the same processing.
- Import ACEScg or ACES2065-1 EXR stills through a user-selected OpenImageIO/OCIO tool. The official ACES 1.3 SDR view is baked into a 16-bit PNG editing copy. This is not a scene-linear ACES timeline or ACES export.
- Develop camera-RAW stills through a user-selected LibRaw tool, with white balance and exposure controls. Actual camera/compression support depends on that decoder. Creates 16-bit sRGB TIFF editing copies, not embedded previews. Motion RAW is not supported.
- Colour tools and models are not downloaded. Original sources stay unchanged; keep editing copies with your project. The existing SDR compositor uses 8-bit surfaces.
- Existing shared video/audio/ink timelines, OBJ meshes, directional shadows and particle interactions remain available.
